preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 10**6 for n in [line.split()[0] for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::3]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 2 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(m, int) and 1 <= m <= n//2 for n, m in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::3]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, m is an integer between 1 and floor(n/2) inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and -10**9 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a) for a in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[2::3]])
preconditions.description: Each element of array a is an integer between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(b, int) and 1 <= b <= n//2 for b in B) for n, B in [(int(line.split()[0]), list(map(int, line.split()))) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[3::3]])
preconditions.description: Each element of set B is a distinct positive integer between 1 and floor(n/2) inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin_text.split('\n')[1::3]]) <= 10**6
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each line of output is a valid integer.

postconditions.expression: all(output_val == max_possible_sum(a, B) for output_val, (a, B) in zip([int(line) for line in stdout_lines], test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the maximum possible sum of the array elements achievable by applying the allowed operations any number of times, where max_possible_sum(a, B) is defined as the maximum sum obtainable by flipping signs of contiguous subarrays of lengths in B.
